sources.note: The brief specifies mm for dimensions and kN for force; use mm and kN.
Quarter domain x,z=0..120 mm; thickness y=0..24 mm from the stated full plate; y up.
Steel is stated; assume isotropic linear elasticity with E=210 kN/mm^2 (210 GPa) and Poisson ratio nu=0.30, since no grade or constants are specified.
1 mm elements explicitly specified; h=1 mm.
Bottom 8 x 8 mm corner pad and fixing x,y,z are stated. Assume pad flush with outer x=0,z=0 edges: x,z=0..8, centre (4,4), y=0. Only this one of the four pads lies in the quarter domain.
Stated symmetry at x=120 implies ux=0 across x+ face, with uy and uz free.
Stated symmetry at z=120 implies uz=0 across z+ face, with ux and uy free.

Full centre is x=z=240/2=120 mm; 20 x 20 mm pad spans 110..130 on each axis. Quarter intersection is 110..120 on each axis, centred at (115,115), on top y=24. Symmetry gives total quarter force 4 kN/4=1 kN downward, vector (0,-1,0) kN, shared equally among patch nodes.

spec.name: Quarter plate with central downward load

supports.note: One of four full-plate corner pads. Assume the 8 x 8 mm pad is flush with the outer x=0 and z=0 edges; bottom face y=0. All translations fixed as explicitly required.

Symmetry plane z=120 mm: zero normal displacement uz; tangential displacements free.

spec.description: Quarter of a 240 x 24 x 240 mm plate, y up. Outer corner is x=z=0; symmetry planes are x=120 and z=120. Central full-plate 4 kN load becomes 1 kN on its 10 x 10 mm quarter pad.
